tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search 135,457+ live, scam-filtered remote jobs (updated hourly). Natural-language queries OK (hybrid semantic search). Returns title, company, location, salary when disclosed, posted date, an employer apply_url, and a canonical detail_url to link back to.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch one job in full (description included) by the 8-hex id that appears at the end of a detail_url.

tools.name: job_facets
tools.description: Counts by source, category, country and tag across the live index — call this first to learn what filters are useful.

description: Remote salary percentiles (p25 / median / p75, USD) per role, from jobs that disclosed pay in the live index, with an optional seniority breakdown. Use this to answer "what does a remote X earn?". Call with no arguments to list every role and its median.

description.name: work_anywhere_scope
description.description: Answer "can I work remotely from <country>?" — returns how many live jobs accept applicants in that country and how many are location-independent (no country restriction). This is eligibility, not a hiring guarantee.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search 135,457+ live, scam-filtered remote jobs (updated hourly). Natural-language queries OK (hybrid semantic search). Returns title, company, location, salary when disclosed, posted date, an employer apply_url, and a canonical detail_url to link back to." → after: "Search 140,647+ live, scam-filtered remote jobs (updated hourly). Natural-language queries OK (hybrid semantic search). Returns title, company, location, salary when disclosed, posted date, an employer apply_url, and a canonical detail_url to link back to."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
